text: Customers are traders with TRDR.SODTYPE 13. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
Suppliers are traders with TRDR.SODTYPE 12. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
TRDR.SODTYPE 14 are financial accounts (banks, cash, notes, loans), not customers or suppliers. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
TRDR.SODTYPE 16 are tax/VAT and other ledger accounts, not customers or suppliers. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)

FINDOC.SOSOURCE 1351 are sales documents (sales and service invoices, retail receipts) AND sales returns; this code alone does not separate returns, and SUMAMNT is not negative for returns, so totals over 1351 are gross of returns. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
FINDOC.SOSOURCE 1253 are purchase and expense invoices received from suppliers (e.g. utility bills). (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
FINDOC.SOSOURCE 1281 are supplier payment receipts. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
FINDOC.SODTYPE 13 means the document is on the customer side (sales, customer collections). (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
FINDOC.SODTYPE 12 means the document is on the supplier side (purchases, supplier payments). (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
FINDOC.SODTYPE 14 means a financial/bank/cash document, not a sale or purchase. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
Goods/products are MTRL.SODTYPE 51. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
Services are MTRL.SODTYPE 52. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
MTRL.SODTYPE 53 are expense items (taxes, interest, costs), not products. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
MTRL.SODTYPE 61 are accounting/ledger entries (VAT lines, values), not products. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
FINDOC.ISCANCEL 0 means the document is not cancelled; the current snapshots contain no cancelled documents. (Evidence: SoftOne series and trader names in the restored backups, verified 2026-11-16.)
